name: Oga (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Oga city emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing two stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Oga, a city in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 2005.

features.role: Oga city emblem — a winged ring enclosing two stylised characters
